newsitem.title: CANADA: Canadian pulp producers plan price increase.
newsitem.headline: Canadian pulp producers plan price increase.

text.p: Two Canadian pulp producers confirmed Thursday plans to increase prices by at least US$50 a tonne starting October 1.
Harmac Pacific Inc said it told customers that its pulp price would rise to US$630 from US$580 while Canfor Corp announced an increase to US$620 from US$560.

Canfor chief financial officer Gordon Armstrong said the move reflects "increased market demand...and paper prices seem to be moving up." But some industry analysts questioned whether customers would accept the increase.
